text.p: Explorations Entertainment Group Inc said Monday it had completed the acquisition of International Tractor Co Inc.
Explorations had previously effected one-for-two reverse stock split and had spun off Explorations assets to the shareholders of its wholly owned subsidiary, Explorations of Boca Raton Inc.
Following its acquisition of International Tractor Co Inc, Explorations changed its name to Worldwide Equipment Corp.

After giving affect to the reverse split, and issuance of one million common shares to Eilat Lev, the sole shareholder of International Tractor and new president of Worldwide Equipment Corp there is now a total of 1,462,375 issued and outstanding shares.
Worldwide Equipment said it is requesting a change in its stock trading symbol to one more closely identified with its operations.

Based in Ardsley, N.Y., International Tractor is engaged primarily in the export of new and used heavy construction equipment traded worldwide. It reported $23.3 million in sales and after-tax income of $688,687 for the year ended August 31, 1996. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
